title: Edgar Allan Poe Museum

services.name: School Groups
services.desc: The Poe Museum offers on-site, virtual, and outreach opportunities for visitors of all ages. Additionally, we offer sensory-friendly and interactive programming for all learners. Our guided tours and programs align with the Virginia Standards of Learning, structured around guiding objectives which build students’ critical thinking, literary, and historical analysis skills. We offer two onsite field trip options: Guided Tour (1 hour) and Guided Tour and Interactive Program (1.5 hour) Booking requests must be made at least 2 weeks in advance.
